start.text:
[TODO:ar] You enter the temple courts with Jesus.
His eyes are steady.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Wait outside, away from trouble
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Do not turn away from the holy.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Walk in beside him with reverence
[TODO:ar] Run ahead to shout warnings

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Come Inside
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The holy place is not for hiding from.
Follow him.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Walk in beside him with reverence

shout_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Loud words come before listening.
Be still.

see_market.text:
[TODO:ar] Tables of coin. Cages of doves.
The holy court has become a market.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Shrug — "This is how it is."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Do not bless what is broken.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Buy a dove to fit in
[TODO:ar] Feel the wrongness with him

shrug_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] It Is Not Right
shrug_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] What is wrong is not made right by time.
Look again.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Feel the wrongness with him

buy_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Not for Sale
buy_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Worship is not bought.
Set the coin down.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Feel the wrongness with him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You step away from the table.

cord.title: [TODO:ar] He Lifts the Cord
cord.text:
[TODO:ar] He weaves a cord of small ropes.
His purpose is clear.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Stop him — "Do not cause trouble."
[TODO:ar] Stand near him, ready to follow

stop_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Let Him Act
stop_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] What looks like trouble is justice waking.
Stand with him.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Stand near him, ready to follow

tables.title: [TODO:ar] Tables Overturned
tables.text:
[TODO:ar] Tables tip. Coins ring on stone.
The air shakes with holy fire.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Grab coins for yourself in the chaos
[TODO:ar] Help clear the path for him
[TODO:ar] Cover your ears and look away

grab_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Drop the Coin
grab_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] You become what is being driven out.
Let it fall.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Help clear the path for him

cover_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Open Your Eyes
cover_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Witness what holiness costs.
Do not look away.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Help clear the path for him

drive_out.title: [TODO:ar] Out You Go
drive_out.text:
[TODO:ar] Merchants hurry away with their cages.
Doves rise into open air.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Mock them as they retreat
[TODO:ar] Open the cages, set doves free

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Without Scorn
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Cleansing is not contempt.
Do good instead.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Open the cages, set doves free

proclaim.title: [TODO:ar] A House of Prayer
proclaim.text:
[TODO:ar] "My house shall be called
a house of prayer."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Argue that trade pays for repairs
[TODO:ar] Receive his words into your heart

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Holiness First
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] What is sacred cannot be sold for upkeep.
Listen again.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Receive his words into your heart

disciples.title: [TODO:ar] They Remember
disciples.text:
[TODO:ar] The disciples watch and remember:
"Zeal for your house consumes him."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Boast that you saw it first
[TODO:ar] Stand quietly, take it in

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Be Humble
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Awe is louder than boasting.
Be still.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Stand quietly, take it in

restored.title: [TODO:ar] Sacred Space
restored.text:
[TODO:ar] Dust settles. Light returns.
The court breathes again.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Refill the tables when he leaves
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Do not rebuild what he tore down.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Pray here as it was meant

refill_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Keep It Clean
refill_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] What was cleansed must stay clean.
Let it be holy.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Pray here as it was meant

ending.title: [TODO:ar] Holy Ground
ending.text:
[TODO:ar] Where corruption was loud,
prayer rises, quiet and bright.
